reviews.classification: historical lens proposals with qualified source and capability gaps
reviews.disposition: Retain KL1–KL12 and KMA1–KMA7 with their own source tiers: institutional versus mechanical ladders, separate rank/class axes, gate events, formula structure, evidence status and independent world profiles. Older no-LOTM-runtime and paused-world status claims are historical, superseded by later source and closure receipts; do not reopen runtime or research from this map. Prose-derived counts and unauthenticated editions remain qualified. The five independent novel profiles retain distinct costs; the B5 observable power-bill trace is not a universal cost dial. No private source or sealed truth is reproduced.
